observations.finding: Black pins match black connectors; silver pins match silver connectors. Older black/orange version uses orange-to-orange and black-to-black.
Click-in system contains locking and non-locking connectors; resistance can occur during assembly. The article does not explicitly map colour to locking function.
Match paired pins and clip entry positions; approach the mating panel. Example shows two connectors on the illustrated mating edge; not a universal quantity rule.
After pin entry, slide panel along elongated clip direction. Page 5 arrow points downward in drawing; page 6 shows seated pins and flush end alignment.

Check aligned, square horizontal/vertical elements before wall fixing; correct front/back offsets with felt-covered board and gentle rubber-mallet taps, from lower elements upward. Preserve helper/stabilisation instructions in customer guidance.
